evaluation: 35 public maintainer-authored Inbox Zero regression cases, never used to fit or calibrate. Compatibility evidence, not production mailbox accuracy. Reviewed source during integration development; not a blind benchmark.
teaching: 140 independently authored English examples, no synthetic expansion or teacher API
calibration: 56 separate authored examples, split by the compiler into temperature and conformal halves
baseline: TF-IDF word unigrams/bigrams, sublinear TF, logistic regression C=1.0; identical fit rows and conformal half, LAC scoring at alpha=0.05
decision: A multi-class or empty prediction set requires review. A point estimate meeting targets on 35 examples still requires mailbox-specific validation before automatic actions.
retuning: Preserve this candidate and its results. Subsequent teaching based on these errors makes this set a regression set and requires fresh independent evaluation.
